text:
marta: Customer reported SSO failures after IdP metadata update — ~25 users hitting 403 at ACS (/saml/consume) since 03:10 UTC. Logs show "Recipient check failed".
devon: Any changes on our side?
marta: None from us. They rotated IdP certs and pushed new metadata. They sit behind an edge redirector which rewrites the ACS to a proxy URL.
saml-sync-bot: fetched metadata for tenant acme-corp at 2026-03-15T03:08:22Z; size=18KB; cert_count=2
marta: Here's the redacted AssertionConsumerService snippet they sent:```xml
<AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST"
  Location="https://app.acme.com/saml/consume" index="0" isDefault="true"/>
<AssertionConsumerService
  Location="https://edge.acme.com/proxy/saml/consume?redir=1" index="1"/>
```\nmarta: Their IdP is including both endpoints in metadata, and the responses are landing at the edge URL with ?redir=1.
devon: Our recipient matching is strict: we compare the exact Location string (including querystring) against the registered ACS. If the IdP posts to the edge URL with the query param we don't accept it.
kevin: Also worth noting: the IdP metadata's KeyDescriptor ordering changed. The signing cert is last in the <KeyDescriptor> chain and our verifier expects leaf-first ordering for chain verification (we were relying on that). We're seeing signature verify failures.
marta: Log snippet: ```saml:signature_verify: failure: bad signature (verified against cert index 1) recipient_check: false```
devon: Short-term workaround for the customer: add the proxy ACS (exact URL including ?redir=1) as an allowed ACS for that tenant in the support console. That will let their assertions through while we patch.
kevin: I'll open ENG-ISSUE-2345. Proposed hotfix: relax ACS matching to ignore specific known redirect query params (strip ?redir and utm-type params) and match by scheme+host+path. Add telemetry to count recipient-mismatch failures.
devon: Medium fix: metadata normalizer on fetch to canonicalize KeyDescriptor/cert order (reorder chain leaf->intermediate) and always compute thumbprints for each cert. Also add tests to accept both chain orders.
marta: Customer confirmed adding the proxy ACS as allowed cleared the 403s for the pilot user. They want a hotfix; said they rotate metadata frequently.
devon: Long-term: suggest IdP use RelayState or keep a single canonical ACS and avoid proxy rewriting. But we should be defensive. I’ll draft a small PR for the hotfix: normalize ACS matching + unit tests + config flag to toggle strict mode.
kevin: Assigning ENG-ISSUE-2345 to devon. ETA: hotfix in ~3 business days, review by me. For immediate support, marta has console access to add ACS entries. :thumbsup:
marta: Adding steps I used to repro locally for engineers: 1) import their metadata into a test tenant 2) craft a SAML response posting to the edge URL (include ?redir=1) 3) verify our recipient check rejects 4) toggle support console to add exact ACS URL and re-repro to confirm acceptance.
devon: Thanks — I'll pick this up. Will post PR link and QA steps.
kevin: Also flagging potential follow-up: if multiple customers use that edge redirector, we should roll the fix behind a feature flag and run it for a single region first.
marta: Closing loop with customer: told them workaround in place and we're prioritizing a hotfix. They asked for notifications when deployed.
